name: hunyuanvideo1.5_1080p_sr_distilled_fp16
role: Optional second stage on the Hunyuan graphs. Not routed.
desc: Ran on 2026-08-18 as part of the first Hunyuan render and cost 231 s on top of the base pass's 257 s, taking one 2-second clip to 488 s. It upscales 1280x704 to 1920x1072 and the measured difference is small - hold_f0 0.946 against the base's 0.958, drift 0.165 against 0.161. It was running by ACCIDENT: ComfyUI's template ships this whole block bypassed, API format has no bypass, and transcribing the template whole made it mandatory. Now split into its own workflow so it is reached on purpose.
weaknesses: Nearly doubles the render time for a difference the measurements do not show at 720p viewing size. Reach for it when the delivery is actually 1080p.

evidence.method: 4-keyframe A/B against LTX-2.3 through studio/_tools/engine_ab.py, same prompt/seed/length/resolution, scored with clipmetrics
evidence.note: n=4. Clean wins (lower drift AND higher evenness on the same shot): LTX 1, Hunyuan 0, split 3. Means favour Hunyuan on drift (0.392 vs 0.429) and evenness (0.665 vs 0.532) by less than the shot-to-shot spread, at 9x the wall clock. Not routed. Clips and strips in ~/shared/AB/honest.
